옳다.e: to be right; to be correct
옳다.n: Adjective: morally or logically right and proper, more formal
cf: to be right; to be correct
Everyday verb: an answer or statement is correct, matches the facts

되받다.n: retort — answer back at once, or receive something in return
cf: to ask back, to ask again (for clarification)
ask back — repeat a question, or answer a question with one
to retrace, to go over again
retrace — go back over an event or path step by step
to get back, to recover (something lost)
recover — find again what you lost, such as calm or health

그까짓.n: standard full form, spoken, belittles a thing near the listener
cf: such as you; the likes of you; a petty one like you
contemptuous, aimed at the listener, rude unless joking with friends
trifling like this; a mere ... like this
belittling something right here, near the speaker

눈웃음.n: warm, charming smile with eyes curving, positive or flirty
cf: awkward or bitter smile from embarrassment, disappointment
hollow laugh; forced laugh; laugh of disbelief
empty laugh from disbelief or absurdity, no real joy

동북쪽.n: Near-synonym; east-first order, common in everyday speech and place names
cf: a northeast part of a country or area
